name: Kaori
source:
A girl who appears before Aoi and his friends one day. 
Bright and ladylike, what lays hidden behind her smile?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180520030931/https://nekocharon.jp/kimiboku-2.html]Official Site[/url]]
